screenFamilies.gap: Search ambiguity/loading and cross-area travel states derive from the shared shell; no full-size dedicated anchor was recovered.
Mobile drawers, keyboard and zoom states are derived designs, not recovered phone screenshots. Physical touch remains separately unverified.
Duplex/shared-circulation and missing-interior variants require a derived state, not fabricated flats.
Reverse section and arbitrary supported floor counts must be coherent derivatives of the same geometry.
Photo gallery has supporting board coverage only; empty/withheld evidence states are derived.
Per-item failure, duplicate replay and conflicting source selection require explicit derived states.
Undo, stale-edit conflict and unsaved recovery states derive from the shared workspace language.
Interrupted/failed publication must retain the previous coherent view; no completed screenshot is evidence for that failure path.

fixtures.name: Complete reference-style synthetic neighbourhood
fixtures.geometryOracle: Explicit generated inputs; retained footprints, heights, road/ground surfaces, selected interior and independently checked quantities.
fixtures.mustNot: Use a single hero building or a static reference image as the complete map.

fixtures.name: Dense irregular Uttam Nagar regression
fixtures.geometryOracle: Byte-retained public/source reference footprints and streets; synthetic heights/units/utilities separately labelled and never reclassified as survey.
fixtures.mustNot: Widen lanes, move buildings, erase courtyards or add a park to match the open reference.

fixtures.name: Slope and split levels
fixtures.geometryOracle: Declared ground surface and storey/utility elevation profiles; independent level and clearance checks.
fixtures.mustNot: Flatten declared elevations or convert unknown depth into a safe interval.

fixtures.name: Holes, multiparts, high rise and sparse geometry
fixtures.geometryOracle: Concave exterior, interior ring, multipart islands and sparse unknown-height cases; compute area from supplied polygons only.
fixtures.mustNot: Substitute bounding boxes, fill holes, infer interiors or hide missing data.

fixtures.name: Road, bridge and utility crossings
fixtures.geometryOracle: Explicit topology plus XY and vertical profiles; touching/overlap and centre/crown/invert/depth use distinct definitions.
fixtures.mustNot: Create a network junction from projected crossing or add overlapping finding regions twice.

fixtures.name: Equivalent source contributions
fixtures.geometryOracle: Equivalent qualified GIS/interchange/schedule fixtures with declared unit/frame conversions; retain every original and exact locator.
fixtures.mustNot: Call roof outline and ground occupation semantically equivalent just because the coordinates match.

fixtures.name: Two-block, frame and tile seams
fixtures.geometryOracle: One 10 by 8 metre building spanning two 20 by 20 authoring blocks; height 6 metres; expected area 80 m2 and prism volume 480 m3 after independent transforms.
fixtures.mustNot: Create a second entity for a block/tile fragment or compare unrelated SRID-0 origins directly.

fixtures.name: Generated catalog with bounded visible workload
fixtures.geometryOracle: Deterministic catalog IDs and fixed visible-route profile; catalog count, loaded objects, triangles and bytes measured separately.
fixtures.mustNot: Claim all catalog objects are simultaneously rendered or make a million-entry catalog a hidden core-release dependency.

fixtures.name: Held-out external shape family
fixtures.geometryOracle: Select a permitted, hashed unfamiliar source before its first transfer test; keep source/version/selection date and contamination history.
fixtures.mustNot: Call a repeatedly tuned fixture held out; retain failures as regression and select another holdout after tuning.

capabilityProfiles.required: Source geometry and role are explicit; incomplete vertical/interior information is visibly limited.
capabilityProfiles.appearance: Neutral, coherent materials and edges without fabricated factual detail.

capabilityProfiles.required: Qualified polygon/height bounds and compatible analytical frames.
capabilityProfiles.appearance: Correct massing, holes, ground contact and defined quantities; no inferred legal rooms.

capabilityProfiles.required: Qualified source-linked levels and spaces with explicit relationships.
capabilityProfiles.appearance: The same floor/unit geometry drives plan, section, model and table.

capabilityProfiles.required: Explicitly synthetic authored geometry and seeded appearance recipe.
capabilityProfiles.appearance: Complete reference-quality neighbourhood; illustrative details excluded from observed analytical quantities.

cameraCases.purpose: Full neighbourhood composition and selected building
Same geometry, parcel and street layout without accidental camera tilt
Facade, roofs and exact selected geometry
Stable identity and no cracks/double rendering at seams

visualGate.rule: Every applicable critical dimension meets its target; no average can hide failed geometry, identity, legibility or interaction. A neutral sparse profile is judged as sparse, not as a fabricated detailed building.

knownContradictions.issue: 20 m2 outside parcel and 12 m2 road portion may overlap; 32 m2 total cannot be assumed.
knownContradictions.resolution: Use exact union/difference result geometry and explicit quantity definitions.

knownContradictions.issue: The illustrative 1.8 metre utility label mixes proximity, horizontal clearance and below-ground language.
knownContradictions.resolution: Use separate distance, depth, reference-surface and vertical-availability fields; no implicit safety finding.

knownContradictions.issue: Floor/footprint/total-area labels vary across concepts without a consistent underlying model.
knownContradictions.resolution: Recompute from the selected canonical fixture; mockup numbers and room counts are not seed truth.

knownContradictions.issue: Source filenames identify different pages than the visible content.
knownContradictions.resolution: Use this inspected content mapping; preserve original filenames and hashes.
